settings.title: Better traction on stairs
settings.text: Stairs have always been uncomfortable for me because my knee often felt unstable. Since I started using the Tredvik sleeve, my knee feels much more stable. It hardly slips at all and remains comfortable to wear even during longer walks.
settings.name: Sarah K.

settings.title: Comfortable for everyday use
settings.text: I wear the compression bandage often at work, and I never would have thought it would be this comfortable. The material feels flexible, and the compression is easy to adjust. I especially like that it’s barely noticeable under my clothes.
settings.name: David T.
